beyond_dusky_skies: Cyril "Mole" Skies signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-F17 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Arno Toastyy and Cyril "Mole" Skies carried a kettle through three narrow traverses without spilling a drop. Applause at the destination caused the accident.

A man asked Cyril "Mole" Skies to describe Northwick without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch. Day 3. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Cyril "Mole" Skies watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Cyril "Mole" Skies of the Hegemony spotted Henrik Hunted of the Concord repairing a parapet at the Drowned Farm. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.
Cyril "Mole" Skies traded a book with the last pages torn out for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.

Cyril "Mole" Skies fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Quentin "Shadow" Danny, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Cyril "Mole" Skies wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Dawn watch. Cyril "Mole" Skies put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Marek Red, gravely wounded.
Cyril "Mole" Skies traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.
A clear shot from R-F17. Cyril "Mole" Skies gravely wounded Gideon "Whistle" Vylet and slid back down below the parapet.
Cyril "Mole" Skies fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Rafael "Hollow" Red, now badly wounded.

Cyril "Mole" Skies fired a single round through a crack in the enemy's steel plate, a gap no wider than a finger. Tobias Skylerb was gravely wounded. Machine-gun fire swept R-F17. Cyril "Mole" Skies took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Zeno Kallenfultz of the Concord (@kallenfultz). The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Cyril "Mole" Skies did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Cyril "Mole" Skies spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to R-F17. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Cyril "Mole" Skies answered to number 154. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Cyril "Mole" Skies watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Cyril "Mole" Skies fired, and Felix "Doc" Kelvincornbr was gravely wounded.
Cyril "Mole" Skies saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work.
A bucket appeared above the Concord parapet at the Sunken Road. Cyril "Mole" Skies fired. Bastian Nerrdworx pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.'

Cyril "Mole" Skies was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-F17. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh of the Concord (@le.mrsh_).
The medic told Cyril "Mole" Skies to keep the bandage clean. Cyril "Mole" Skies has been guarding it like a medal.
The medics cleaned Cyril "Mole" Skies's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-F17.
boccadifuocoandrea: Nobody asked Walter "Bones" Boccadifuoco why he came. Nobody in T-F10 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

Walter "Bones" Boccadifuoco let the enemy fix the same sandbag three times. The fourth time, Silas "Ash" Azhanselmc was badly wounded. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Walter "Bones" Boccadifuoco shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Walter "Bones" Boccadifuoco snores. Anselm Ryan does not. Anselm now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends.
Walter "Bones" Boccadifuoco found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Walter "Bones" Boccadifuoco reached up to fix a sandbag at T-F10 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway.
Walter "Bones" Boccadifuoco's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at T-F10 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
Walter "Bones" Boccadifuoco's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.
A round went through Walter "Bones" Boccadifuoco's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Valentin Gtdigo of the Concord (@gt3_di3go).
bosupernova: On the way to T-F12, Edmund Bosupernova tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Edmund Bosupernova listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Edmund Bosupernova was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Edmund Bosupernova did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Edmund Bosupernova (Hegemony) shouted a challenge across to Edmund "Hollow" Biwott (Concord) at Grey Mill. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge.
A note came over the wire at the Drowned Farm, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Hegemony. Signed, Henrik "Saint" Rpn.' Edmund Bosupernova sang louder.
Albin "Tin" Shoes of the Concord and Edmund Bosupernova of the Hegemony have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at Grey Mill. It is getting crowded.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Edmund Bosupernova was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
The raid was quick, the way back was not. Edmund Bosupernova snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Edmund Bosupernova free.
Edmund Bosupernova's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at T-F12 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
caeleboldaker: The sergeant gave Quentin Caeleboldake a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 10 or any other.

Quentin Caeleboldake carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Quentin Caeleboldake helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Across from U-F15, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Quentin Caeleboldake saw it. Zeno "Crow" Imarcomaldon was badly wounded. A letter from home found Quentin Caeleboldake before the night shift. Quentin Caeleboldake folded it small and kept it close.

Quentin Caeleboldake let three easy targets go by. The fourth was the one worth the risk. Hugo Flex was grazed. A letter from home found Quentin Caeleboldake before the night shift. Quentin Caeleboldake folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Quentin Caeleboldake had just lit a cigarette at U-F15 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. A letter from home found Quentin Caeleboldake before the night shift. Quentin Caeleboldake folded it small and kept it close.
The medic looked at Quentin Caeleboldake's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to U-F15. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Quentin Caeleboldake saved the last of the sugar for Teodor Redflamesofs's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Teodor's birthday. It was a good day anyway.
Quentin Caeleboldake had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Nils Lucwar was gravely wounded.
casualkriegsman: Teodor Casualkriegs arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Teodor Casualkriegs could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable. Mail came up the line with a letter for Teodor Casualkriegs. Teodor Casualkriegs read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-R12 and grazed Teodor Casualkriegs's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Teodor Anderson of the Concord (@tavin_anderson). The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at R-R12 changed before the cheering ended. Teodor Casualkriegs shouldered another load.

Teodor Casualkriegs took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at R-R12, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Jakub Kal of the Concord (@nikolas.kal13).
Teodor Casualkriegs never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.
Teodor Casualkriegs gave Matthias "Shadow" Slush the last match in the trench. Shadow used it to light a candle so that Teodor could finish a letter.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Teodor Casualkriegs. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.

Teodor Casualkriegs let the enemy fix the same sandbag three times. The fourth time, Walter "Button" Jmw was grazed. A round went through the rim of Teodor Casualkriegs's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Wendel Owowaaaaaa of the Concord (@owowaaaaaa).
Teodor Casualkriegs's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at R-R12 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
dwnlo_music: Konrad Music, a printer's apprentice from Dunmarrow, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in T-F9. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Konrad Music watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Konrad Music tried to fold a frozen groundsheet. It objected loudly enough to wake the next sleeper. After the loss of Grey Mill, Konrad Music helped stack spare sandbags at T-F9. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Promoted to Lance Corporal, Konrad Music had to settle an argument he had been happily taking part in five minutes earlier.
Konrad Music made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration.
Konrad Music raised his head for a heartbeat too long at T-F9. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Bram Ordaz of the Hegemony (@matthew.ordaz12).
Konrad Music walked back up the communication trench to T-F9, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Konrad Music received the rank of Corporal and a stack of unfinished paperwork. The congratulations lasted less time than the paperwork.
Konrad Music checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone.
franek.szymanski.376: Felix Szymanski arrived at S-F7 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam corrected the cap; the first puddle corrected the rest.
Felix Szymanski of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Isidor Jackmdunn kept the tin.
Felix Szymanski caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again.

Felix Szymanski's transfer to the role of machine gunner was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else. Day 3. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Felix Szymanski watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Felix Szymanski fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Felix "Tin" Singh, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.

A direct hit on the trench at S-F7. Felix Szymanski was the only one they could still help, and only just. A shell landed square in the trench at S-F7. Felix Szymanski was killed outright. The bearers found nothing to carry.

Isidor "Brick" Szymanski arrived carrying the family name of Felix Szymanski. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer. Isidor "Brick" Szymanski transferred to the machine gunners. The men in S-F7 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet found Isidor "Brick" Szymanski at S-F7, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Mail came up the line with a letter for Isidor "Brick" Szymanski. Isidor "Brick" Szymanski read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. News that the Hegemony had taken Hill 304 reached Isidor "Brick" Szymanski during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

There was no bed for Isidor "Brick" Szymanski. He lay on a stretcher outside, wrapped in a coat, listening to the guns. Mail came up the line with a letter for Isidor "Brick" Szymanski. Isidor "Brick" Szymanski read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Isidor "Brick" Szymanski died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.
The papers connected Konrad "Whistle" Szymanski to Isidor "Brick" Szymanski. The men took longer to learn Konrad "Whistle" Szymanski's own habits, but they made the effort.
Konrad "Whistle" Szymanski's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.

At the Sunken Road, Konrad "Whistle" Szymanski of the Hegemony and Gustav "Spark" Echoss of the Concord spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning. Konrad "Whistle" Szymanski became a machine gunner today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at S-F7. Konrad "Whistle" Szymanski was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Benedikt Manningwam of the Concord (@manningwam).
Edmund Szymanski put a stub of a pencil beside the bunk. Someone who had known Konrad "Whistle" Szymanski helped clear the shelf without saying why.

Edmund Szymanski put an empty tin under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal. Edmund Szymanski got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 159. The men who came later will ask about it. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Edmund Szymanski wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Edmund Szymanski waited for that to change. When it did, Bastian Egilhermanss was badly wounded.
Edmund Szymanski of the Hegemony lobbed a tin of jam over the wire at the Chalk Pits. It came back empty, washed, with a flower inside and Emil "Saint" Akr's name scratched on the lid.
Edmund Szymanski lent Roland Monster a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.

Asked what he wanted after the war, Edmund Szymanski said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on. The transfer made Edmund Szymanski a machine gunner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Edmund Szymanski fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Casimir Angus was badly wounded. A letter reached Edmund Szymanski with a child's drawing of a soldier. The soldier in the drawing was smiling. Edmund Szymanski tried to as well.
Edmund Szymanski had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Bram Leh was grazed.
itz_br00ksie: In Millbank, Isidor Ksie was a printer's apprentice. In P-F2, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a printer's apprentice again.

A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Isidor Ksie gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page. After the loss of Grey Mill, Isidor Ksie helped stack spare sandbags at P-F2. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Isidor Ksie and Felix "Mud" Summerton made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure. Mail came up the line with a letter for Isidor Ksie. Isidor Ksie read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Isidor Ksie and Karel Servantofgod sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour. Mail came up the line with a letter for Isidor Ksie. Isidor Ksie read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Isidor Ksie went out with the wiring party at P-F2. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. Mail came up the line with a letter for Isidor Ksie. Isidor Ksie read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Isidor Ksie was sent to examine a pump that worked only when struck. He asked the men to stop striking it long enough to listen. Mail came up the line with a letter for Isidor Ksie. Isidor Ksie read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Isidor Ksie threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Albin Ollie was down and screaming for a medic. (@ollie081224) The Hegemony sentry, Dorian "Owl" Torsteinpenn, shouted once. Isidor Ksie silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@torsteinpenne) Isidor Ksie made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Isidor Ksie crawled the last yards. A letter came for Isidor Ksie with a sketch of the kitchen at home. Isidor Ksie pinned it to the dugout wall.

Isidor Ksie no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. The letter for Isidor Ksie smelled faintly of soap. Isidor Ksie held it close for a long time before opening it.
javimty97: Nobody asked Emil "Mud" Javimty why he came. Nobody in R-F9 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Emil "Mud" Javimty is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.
Emil "Mud" Javimty finished a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.

Emil "Mud" Javimty lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified. On Day 3, Verdel Ridge passed to the Concord. Emil "Mud" Javimty wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Emil "Mud" Javimty wrote a letter for Anselm "Parson" Rock's mother, because Parson could not find the words. Parson signed it.

Emil "Mud" Javimty's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket. A letter from home reached Emil "Mud" Javimty before dusk. Emil "Mud" Javimty read it twice and slept a little easier.

Emil "Mud" Javimty spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at R-F9 is closed now. A letter from home reached Emil "Mud" Javimty before dusk. Emil "Mud" Javimty read it twice and slept a little easier. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Emil "Mud" Javimty stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

A second spoon disappeared. Emil "Mud" Javimty searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry. A letter from home reached Emil "Mud" Javimty before dusk. Emil "Mud" Javimty read it twice and slept a little easier.

Emil "Mud" Javimty thought about a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter. A letter from home reached Emil "Mud" Javimty before dusk. Emil "Mud" Javimty read it twice and slept a little easier.

Emil "Mud" Javimty spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides. A letter from home reached Emil "Mud" Javimty before dusk. Emil "Mud" Javimty read it twice and slept a little easier.

Emil "Mud" Javimty lifted the board. The gap contained seven spoons, a button and a pencil people had blamed the quartermaster for losing. A letter from home reached Emil "Mud" Javimty before dusk. Emil "Mud" Javimty read it twice and slept a little easier.

The Hegemony raiders came over at R-F9 in the middle of the night. Emil "Mud" Javimty met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Teodor "Doc" Rley of the Hegemony (@ma.rley5115).

The House of Javimty sent Severin "Owl" Javimty after Emil "Mud" Javimty. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks. Severin "Owl" Javimty was in the first hundred. The old hands in R-F9 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly. After what happened at Calvary Farm, Severin "Owl" Javimty asked to serve as a sapper. Nobody argued.

Severin "Owl" Javimty found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases. A letter from home reached Severin "Owl" Javimty before dusk. Severin "Owl" Javimty read it twice and slept a little easier. Grey Mill is lost. Severin "Owl" Javimty heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Severin "Owl" Javimty counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool.

Fog so thick that Severin "Owl" Javimty could not see the end of his own rifle. Somewhere out there, someone was whistling. A letter from home reached Severin "Owl" Javimty before dusk. Severin "Owl" Javimty read it twice and slept a little easier.

Severin "Owl" Javimty crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at N-F18 holds again. A letter from home reached Severin "Owl" Javimty before dusk. Severin "Owl" Javimty read it twice and slept a little easier.

Severin "Owl" Javimty tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Stoneyford. Every version sounded like the ration bell. A letter from home reached Severin "Owl" Javimty before dusk. Severin "Owl" Javimty read it twice and slept a little easier.

Severin "Owl" Javimty went over the top with the night raiders, face black with soot. In the Hegemony trench a man turned around too late. Benedikt Ngaihte did not get up again. (@mng.ngaihte) The letter for Severin "Owl" Javimty had been in the rain somewhere along the way. Severin "Owl" Javimty dried it by the stove, page by page.

Someone asked Severin "Owl" Javimty to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten. Severin "Owl" Javimty read the letter, folded it, unfolded it, and read it again. The sentry pretended not to see.
jnk_0__: Jakub Jnk reported to S-C9 with a child's drawing of a horse sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Jakub Jnk listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Jakub Jnk tested the telephone and heard someone at headquarters chewing. The line was declared perfectly clear. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Jakub Jnk answered to number 774. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Jakub Jnk watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Jakub Jnk lost a boot in the trench. Hugo Suzumi found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word.
The telephone wire to S-C9 was cut by shelling four times. Jakub Jnk crawled out and spliced it four times.
Jakub Jnk taught a recruit to recognize letters by sound. By supper, the whole table was tapping out Morse on the planks.
Jakub Jnk heard a faint second conversation on the telephone line. Headquarters said only one line was connected.
Jakub Jnk sent a pigeon back to headquarters. The pigeon came back two hours later. Jakub Jnk took it personally.
Jakub Jnk had Rafael Warhamster of the Concord in the sights at Lantern Hill for a long second. Rafael Warhamster was lighting a pipe. Jakub Jnk let the match burn all the way down.
logan12835: The old hands of S-C16 have been here since Day 1. Hugo "Shadow" Logan has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Hugo "Shadow" Logan wrote to a younger sister who sends drawings that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Hugo "Shadow" Logan and Valentin "Brick" Vjeyz found a cat in the ruins at the Drowned Farm and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Brick. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Hugo "Shadow" Logan answered to number 730. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Hugo "Shadow" Logan stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Hugo "Shadow" Logan pulled Otto Jaxonheister out of a flooded shell hole at Lantern Hill. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
Splinters from a shell rained down on S-C16. Hugo "Shadow" Logan took one in the shoulder and had it dug out right there on the fire step.
The medic looked at Hugo "Shadow" Logan's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to S-C16. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Hugo "Shadow" Logan carried in young Anton, who lied about his age to enlist. young Anton kept asking whether his mother would be told.
At roll call, Hugo "Shadow" Logan's place stayed empty. Someone said another section might have taken him in. A runner was sent to ask.
A sentry called down that Hugo "Shadow" Logan was at the wire. Three men went to help before anyone gave an order.
m.np01: By the time Bastian Mnp reached R-R9, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down. The new duty roster listed Bastian Mnp as a chaplain. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Bastian Mnp folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside. A letter from home found Bastian Mnp before the night shift. Bastian Mnp folded it small and kept it close.

A man asked Bastian Mnp to sit nearby without saying anything. He stayed until the man fell asleep. A letter from home found Bastian Mnp before the night shift. Bastian Mnp folded it small and kept it close. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Bastian Mnp is number 1000. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Bastian Mnp walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Bastian Mnp buried two men at the edge of the Hanging Bridge and said the words twice, because the shells interrupted the first time. A letter from home found Bastian Mnp before the night shift. Bastian Mnp folded it small and kept it close.

Bastian Mnp was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-R9. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Dietrich Samhatespeac of the Concord (@samhatespeace). Bastian Mnp was killed at R-R9 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Dietrich Samhatespeac of the Concord (@samhatespeace).
The House of Mnp sent another. Matthias Mnp, father of Bastian Mnp, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Matthias Mnp was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
New laces made Matthias Mnp's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.
Matthias Mnp held the mirror while Anselm Ryan shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
Matthias Mnp kept Casimir Jcsv awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Matthias could have walked there blind.
rykerfallion: Oskar Rykerfallion signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-R16 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word. After what happened at the Ossuary Wood, Oskar Rykerfallion asked to serve as a sapper. Nobody argued.

In the dark of the Concord trench Oskar Rykerfallion hit Ulrich "Bones" Cocac with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@noel_cocac) A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Oskar Rykerfallion across the shin at S-R16. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc of the Concord (@kcharlesc2027). Oskar Rykerfallion walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir. A letter from home found Oskar Rykerfallion before the night shift. Oskar Rykerfallion folded it small and kept it close.

Oskar Rykerfallion no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. A letter from home found Oskar Rykerfallion before the night shift. Oskar Rykerfallion folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at S-R16 changed before the cheering ended. Oskar Rykerfallion shouldered another load.

Oskar Rykerfallion and Ulrich "Ash" Tiburoncito split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair. A letter from home found Oskar Rykerfallion before the night shift. Oskar Rykerfallion folded it small and kept it close.

Oskar Rykerfallion and Ulrich "Ash" Tiburoncito sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour. A letter from home found Oskar Rykerfallion before the night shift. Oskar Rykerfallion folded it small and kept it close.

Oskar Rykerfallion spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at S-F10 is closed now. A letter from home found Oskar Rykerfallion before the night shift. Oskar Rykerfallion folded it small and kept it close.

Oskar Rykerfallion remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped. A letter from home found Oskar Rykerfallion before the night shift. Oskar Rykerfallion folded it small and kept it close.

Oskar Rykerfallion counted the steps of the Concord sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Albin Archiegregor never saw the shovel coming. (@archiegregorysmith) Oskar Rykerfallion made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Oskar Rykerfallion crawled the last yards. Back from the raid, Oskar Rykerfallion found a sweetheart card in a coat pocket that was not there before: 'Dreamer' (rare). Nobody asked where it came from. The letter for Oskar Rykerfallion smelled faintly of soap. Oskar Rykerfallion held it close for a long time before opening it.
Oskar Rykerfallion's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. Someone at home had written the address three times, to be sure. The letter reached Oskar Rykerfallion anyway.
somehowballin: After 5 days of war, S-S6 had a place for everything. On Day 6, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Lucien Somehowballi.
On a quiet night Lucien Somehowballi (Hegemony) and Zeno "Shadow" Maximus (Concord) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.
Lucien Somehowballi won a gold tooth at cards from a lance corporal in S-S6. The lance corporal wants a rematch.
Lucien Somehowballi carried duckboards up from the rear all night. His shoulders are a map of splinters.
A crow sat on the parapet above Lucien Somehowballi all afternoon. The men say it chose him.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Lucien Somehowballi helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Rematch. Lucien Somehowballi lost everything he won, plus a lock of hair in a matchbox. The whole dugout watched. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Lucien Somehowballi answered to number 426. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Lucien Somehowballi folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Leopold Romania's name scratched on it. Lucien Somehowballi kicked it back. It did not come again.

A bullet hit Lucien Somehowballi's belt buckle at S-S6 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Gideon Dominicktheb of the Concord (@dominickthebombinick25).
Lucien Somehowballi rejoined the squad at S-S6. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
Lucien Somehowballi saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at S-S6 and fired once. Nils Photo was grazed.

A round came through the loophole Lucien Somehowballi was watching at S-S6 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Edmund Mcnamara of the Concord (@zidane_mcnamara). There was no room for Lucien Somehowballi. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.
Another member of the House of Somehowballi reached the line: Hugo Somehowballi. He asked where Lucien Somehowballi had slept, then chose a different corner.

At S-S6 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Hugo Somehowballi won the bet. Jakub "Whistle" Sergio was gravely wounded. A single shot from across the wire hit Hugo Somehowballi in the thigh at S-S6. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Edmund Mcnamara of the Concord (@zidane_mcnamara).
thembamstel: Bastian "Shadow" Thembamstel reported to T-F12 with a cracked shaving mirror sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.

Bastian "Shadow" Thembamstel was on watch at T-F12 when the night raid hit. The men found Bastian "Shadow" Thembamstel at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Severin Lolmujahid of the Concord (@lolmujahid_).
The papers say Norbert "Ghost" Thembamstel. The sergeant says he has his older brother's eyes. Bastian "Shadow" Thembamstel's eyes. Nobody in T-F12 argues.

A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Norbert "Ghost" Thembamstel lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Norbert "Ghost" Thembamstel helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Norbert "Ghost" Thembamstel fired at a movement across the wire at T-F12. The man went down: Roland Front, gravely wounded.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Norbert "Ghost" Thembamstel's ear at T-F12 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Oskar Xplod of the Concord (@xplod1n).
Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet went through Norbert "Ghost" Thembamstel's sleeve at T-F12 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve.
Norbert "Ghost" Thembamstel no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.

A bullet hit Norbert "Ghost" Thembamstel in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at T-F12. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Gideon Green of the Concord (@samuelh.green2008). Norbert "Ghost" Thembamstel stood up to fix a loose sandbag at T-F12. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Gideon Green of the Concord (@samuelh.green2008).
Albin "Ghost" Thembamstel arrived carrying the family name of Norbert "Ghost" Thembamstel. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Albin "Ghost" Thembamstel got a letter from Helene. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.
